parsed_description.jobDescription: Design, implement, and deliver scalable infrastructure for government services. Develop end-to-end systems using DevOps, JavaScript, and Python.
responsibilities: Design, review, and build software with fellow engineers
Collaborate with government partners and contractors to architect and deploy new systems
Work in an agile manner to ship new features
Create tools and processes to automate development workflows
Write and review technical documentation and perform code reviews
Participate in on-call rotation to support production systems
Take part in hiring activities as needed

requirements.experience: At least 6 years of hands-on professional work experience building web applications and creating APIs
skills: Web and mobile user interface design best practices
softSkills: Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Adaptive, empathetic, collaborative, and positive mindset

benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
Disability, life, and accidental death insurance

Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship
